head: New app Streamline shows which streaming services you can cancel
dek: Streamline works out the smallest set of streaming subscriptions that covers the shows you actually watch, and which ones you could cancel without losing a show. It was #26 among paid Entertainment apps on the US App Store on 3 November.
details: You add your shows and the services you pay for; it shows where each show streams and how much you could save. It costs $1.99 once, by developer Brad Cooper.
means: If you pay for several streaming services, it can show which ones you don't need for your shows.
todo: Add the shows you watch and the services you pay for, then check its suggestion against your own bills before cancelling.
